_PROVENANCE.purpose: Decompose the HydroViT transfer-gap headline (chl-a 4-band R2 ~0.21 -> red-edge indices R2 ~0.34) into ADDED-BAND vs index-REPRESENTATION, on the SAME real 6-band tiles.
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/biology/noaa_habs/mc_tiles (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A 6-band) x mc_fusion_dataset.parquet (REAL WQP/NOAA in-situ chl-a).

arms.raw6 (A): raw per-band spatial stats, all 6 bands, NO ratios
arms.idx6 (B): engineered indices incl NDCI/CIre/MCIre/FAI (need B05/B11), NO raw stats
arms.raw4 (C): raw per-band spatial stats, 4 HydroViT bands only, NO ratios

decomposition.added_band_effect: A - C (raw6 vs raw4): value of the extra B05/B11 BAND
decomposition.representation_effect: B - A (idx6 vs raw6): value of the index REPRESENTATION on SAME bands
decomposition.rep_4band_control: D - C (idx4 vs raw4): do indices help WITHOUT the new band
decomposition.total_headline: B - C (idx6 vs raw4): the paper's ~0.21 -> ~0.34 gain

_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site) GroupKFold; no site shared train/test.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples sites), 2000 reps; paired deltas.
_PROVENANCE.model: identical CPU HistGradientBoosting for all arms (no per-arm tuning).

attribution_of_total_gain.note: shares are mean-delta ratios; interpret with the CIs above.

verdict_text: BOTH the added red-edge band (A-C positive) AND the index representation on top of it (B-A positive) contribute; the headline gain is partly information, partly representation.
